title: RPSC Physiotherapist Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Physiotherapist posts under RPSC / Rajasthan Medical & Health services as advertised
qualification: Bachelor / Master degree in Physiotherapy with registration as per RPSC notification
applicationFee: General/Other State ~₹600; reserved categories lower as per RPSC (check advt)
selectionProcess: Written Examination / Screening → Interview / DV as per RPSC scheme
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Physiotherapist recruitment apply online
3. Complete SSO login if required
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit before last date
shortDescription: RPSC Physiotherapist Online Form 2026 – apply for Physiotherapist posts at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has invited online applications for Physiotherapist recruitment.

Candidates with BPT/MPT and valid registration should apply on rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in after reading the full advertisement for vacancies, age and selection process.
